item.title: Jackson · 2026-09-08 · Commissioners - 2nd Tuesday (Regular Commission Meeting): Request: Set a public hearing for first reading and approval of changes to County Ordinance Chapter 2 Administration - Tyler Schaeffer, Procurement Officer
item.description: This item repeals the County's 1989 purchasing ordinance (Chapter 2, Article III, Division 2) and adopts a new Division 2, "Procurement." The new ordinance sets the legal framework for County purchasing, while the Purchasing Policy handles the day-to-day procedures. Dollar thresholds move out of the ordinance and into the Policy, where the Board can adjust them by vote instead of amending the Code. The update also adds federal procurement requirements for federally funded purchases, brings the local preference in line with state and federal law, and adds provisions the old code was missing, which include competitive proposals, emergency purchasing, cooperative purchasing, protest procedures, and ethics standards.
